[b]Inostrancevia founds 'Council of Foreign wildlife management'[/b]

Inostrancevia has been shaped by its wildlife, and has prided itself in its uniqueness, and the arrival of foreign species illegally and legally imported has caused some Environmental disruption on some islands.The Council will have the power to investigate and detain offenders, Unless God King Welar Objects.

[quote=-chimor;59123048][b]Starbound[/b]
[b]Chòrónkô system[/b]
Chòrónkô is a orange dwarf , similar to Urûntù but bit more massive, not much, and similar activity, being more stable than average yellow dwarfs and hosting better habitability than red dwarfs.
Is also known for being home system of the Bloxori, a sencient(even tho a little) specie, the only specie the Chimor enslaved due their great medicine properties.
The system is about 2 billion years old, has a long lifespan expected to happen, colonization began around 2200.
[b]Sànsachálk[/b]
"Lava path", the first planet on the system, as the name says, it proximity to it star make much lava on it surface, having a very molten surface, despite this name, the planet has indeed few solid parts, filled by volcanoes, it rotates too slow, this means, it slowly burn while orbiting it star.
The planet has many "volcanoes"(more like fonts of lava,  but volcano is better to say), which in a almost daily frequency they erupt, the lack of a atmosphere allows the gases made by the planet to quickly escape to the vacuum of space.
There is no atmosphere at all, and the surface does constantly changes the closer it gets to it star and the more it volcanoes erupt, "volcanoes" not last long, and  many eruptions ocurr from fissures on it surface when the molten crust over the planet "broke" and then throw gas and form temporary rivers of lava, a true helholle.
Sansachálkis a medium sized planet, the core is made up of several radioctive elements taht help it volcanism, it surface is rich in metals, but no one dares to land there, the only rocky planet on this system the Chimor never landed, or even showed interest. There is only one sattelite around it to study the planet Geology, called Sansachálk-A.
A image representing Chápalk surface: https://ibb.co/pr2s7j9Z
[b]Llárapayor[/b].
[i]Orange Sky[/i], this planet, despite Urûntù's planets also having a orange sky, the one of Llrárapayor is way more...bright, caused by a mix of a mist of dust and the yellowish-orange soil.
Llárapayor is desertic, and has many rocks, dunes most of it surface, on Equator there are a few lakes feed by underground aquifer, while most of the planet is dry, with average temperatures of 30-40 degrees on day and 15-20  degrees on night and a atmosphere composed of nytrogen, water steam and methane mostly, while a mist of iron oxide taht make the sky orange even more intense, however, the same mist is essential for the life on the planet to reproduce.
Life in Llárapayor:
The life of Llárapayor is limited to the rocks in regions closer to lakes, as during rains they can get hydrated easier, they are similar to lichens, but with colour of rust, they are colonies of microorganisms spread over rocky soil or rocks, either land or on sea, the mist of iron oxide spread them to reproduce via assexual reproduction in a process called "fragmentation".
The iron oxide mist helps severely life as conduction of eletrons, and alongside silicate, it get in a "symbiote relation" as the "lichens" use them as form to protect the structure of the colonies from the direct light of it  star and radiation.
While these colonies get energy from anaerobic way, making they have a very slow metabolism as result.
 The more complex life is limited to worms who eat the "rust crust" of the lichens, while after dying, these worms are eaten by bacterias which liberate methane, making a stable place, all life in Llárapayor has anaerobic breathing using, either methane or even the iron oxide itself, the lower metabolism makes the beings of the planet being known for their longevity, a single worm, perhaps the most complex lifeform there, can live up to a few dozens to hundreds of yeats due lower metabolism, the oldest living beings are archaeas in more extreme places at deep sea producing methane.
The Chimú decided to make some stations on the planet to study it lifeforms, while some planetary simple defenses were built to protect the system, the mining was seem as unprofitable and potentially risky.
Fun Fact: During storms the iron oxide transport the lichen fragmentation very far away, during the cooler seasons where there is more water, Lichens of tones between yellow, orange and red can be found over most of the planet.

[b]Bloxorior[/b]
A planet home to the Bloxori, a ameboid like specie, the Bloxori.
Bloxorior is a super Erene, being about 1,5 times larger than Erene, it has two moons (one about size of Enceladus the other of Io irl), which cause interesting effects on the planet.
While most of surface is covered in water, the planet also shows high humidity, as if it was a "tropical planet", with temperatures going from 25-32 degrees.
The atmosphere is made up similarly to Erene, with nytrogen mostly, then oxygen, and water steam taht keep humidity and the many rains on the planet.
[b]Bloxori[/b]
Their body is mostly gelatinous, with size varying from 1 meter to 1,5 meters as they can change as they want, being very flexible, while a few silicate structures are in their body, they are almost impossible to be seen, their function is to provide stability on the creature's structure.
Their body is translucent, making able to see their organelles and nucleus, and making them capable of easily camouflage themselves into water to escape predation...which is rare.
Their liquid body is made up of cytoplasm, they have two nucleus, one is made for the general things to make them live and move, the other is focused on reproduction, being capable of regeneration, it can divide itself to generate new Bloxori in a very quick amount of time.
They do not "eat" properly saying, all they do is just...absorb nutrients brought by the air humidity or then enter in the water to absorb anything taht their pseudopots detect and then engulf, allowing it absorption, the "food" then pass throught channels of cytoplasm to food vacuoles where it is transformed into energy and then goes to a Golgi complex and then "liberated" into their bodies, while a little part is given to pseudopods to cause propulsion, which make sounds similar to flatulence taht is used by Bloxori as a primitive way of communication.
Other organelles include contractile vacuoles, which are structures taht act as "filter", making them not absorb too much water, taht is why they do not "explode" when entering water neither the high humidity on the air, mitochondria, which function is to, when the air is captured, the humidity goes to the contractile vacuole, the nutrients to food vacuoles, and the oxygen goes to the mitochondria then transformed into energy.
Their high regenerative rate is ...great?
If someone pierce throught their body membrane it will be "blocked" very quickly, as long it does not hit any organelle, their metabolism is known for being a bit....slow, at least for the land populaces , so much taht the Chimor even wondered if those things even know they existed and how they managed to organize themselves into communities up to hundreds and thousands in caves (the Chimú only knew the land populaces at first)their "enslavement" is literally bring them to laboratories and use their bodies to make medicine, their high reproduction rate allows them to quickly substitute the killed ones, the "kidnapped ones" are Bloxori from waters , which have a higher metabolism due to a symbiont relation with chemosynthetic bacteria taht produce produce a almost "unlimited" font of nutrients, the two main populations of Bloxori are the "land" and the "sea", they are two different species of the same family.
[b]Other lifeforms in Bloxorior[/b]
Not only Bloxori exist in Bloxorior, there is a reason the planet is called by some a "autumn rainforest", the trees are similar to the ones in Erene, with the difference taht their leaf have colours varying from orange to yellow tones, the Bloxori of land use these trees for reproduction, leaving parts of themselves into the trees, growing in a gelatinous mass taht will slowly "eat" the tree's nutrients until it can leave the tree, such process will not kill the tree.
While on sea, many other gelatinous creatures exist, translucent algae, translucent small fish and many Jellyfishes, who can make a hive mind when many are together, other smaller ones also make up great part of sea, some bioluminescent jellyfishes make the planet also a beautiful sight at night.
 on the air, large floating jellyfish taht float on air via "bags" with hydrogen in it,  they are giant creatures taht seem like giant balloons, they keep floating by transforming massive amounts of air into energy, while it also feeds them, they make usage of bacteria taht produce organic matter for them, their "tentacles" produce a toxin enough to kill a adult man in seconds, other "birds" exist, they are the few predators of the planet, small in size but when in group they can be very dangerous to the "balloon jellies", piercing their bodies.
While on land, most lifeforms are just insects, with small crabs with tall long shells on coastal areas.
Great part of Chimú cities on Chòrónkô system are in Bloxorior, the great conditions make people capable of living here perfectly, without many problems, about 150 million people already live in Bloxorior, the capital is Cholkpa.
[b]Mancuapù[/b]
Large rock", the largest planet of inner system , Mancuapù is about 3 times more massive than Erene, and for many, the "great shield" of inner  Chòrónkô, as any asteroid taht come from the belt, is either captured by gas giants, or then bby Mancuapù, how it is so large or massive is unknown, but some believe it formation explain why the gas planets of the system are so smaller than average.
Mancuapù gravity is crushing, and the atmosphere thick, thick of many gases, caused by many asteroids, such as ammonia, oxygen, nytrogen, and others, the surface very active geologically speaking of many volcanoes, which activity is caused by radioactive elements in it core, despite not as  frequent in 
Sànsachálk, it volcanoes can erupt, while the surface is made up of many valuable resources, around 2463, the first mines were built on the planet's surface, the Chimú greed for resources made them mine the planet's surface.
The resources, such as iron, aluminun, nickel, magnesium, chromium, and others are the most common in Mancuapù's surface.
The planet has 4 moons, not nearly as big as Erene's moon, being very small in comparation, named as Mancuapù A-D.
[b]Chiriapù [/b]
"Frozen stone", a smaller planet, but still can be considered a planet, Chiriapù is the last  inner planet of Chòrónkô , it is believed taht it was originally formed as a planet in the outer system, but tensions between early gas dwarves and Mancuapù made Chiriapù get into inner system, without being captured by Mancuapù's influence, and if it did, Chiriapù could not even exist.
The planet surface is mostly frozen, composed of ice and rocks, there is potassium, and uranium, tho the last is in smaller amounts compared to the first, magnesium, iron copper and zinc are also fairly common, such minerals are mined by many stations and outposts of Chimú on the planet.
The planet has a thin atmosphere, composed of methane and nytrogen, there are massive oceans underground the planet alongside caves, as if there was a entire "new surface" below the sheets of ice and rock, there was detected life on such places, even tho microscopic .
[B] Whisperer belt[/b]
A belt of asteroids, known for it "whispering sounds" taht are detected from getting closer, the reason this phenomenon happens is unknown.

[b]Gas dwarves[/b]
After the belt of asteroids, there are "GV", such planets are called GV-1, GV-2 and GV-3  respectively, they all show similar characteristics, a dense atmosphere made up of helium and hydrogen, while also being present nytrogen and oxygen, GV-1 is the biggest on the system, being three times  bigger than Mancuapù, GV-3 is the smallest, being even slighty bigger than Mancuapù, all they have ring belts exept by the third.
All of them have moons, 12 for GV-1, 7 for GV-2 and 3 for GV-3, they are simply named as:
Chiri 1-12 in GV-1
Apù 1-7 in GV-2
Muy 1-3 in GV-3
Some believe taht Mancuapù could have become a potential Gas dwarf of it system, but something unknown made  it migrate to inner system and absorbing much of denser elements, making it the size has today, a "failed gas planet", it was formed around the same time the gas dwarves formed as well, potentially even earlier.
The gas dwarves formation made one capture each other before moving into the inner system, making them outer, they also can protect inner planets from asteroids due to their powerful gravity.
[nation]Shahzada[/nation] RP[/quote]
Life cycle of the Bloxori(Water Bloxori).
[b] Fragment[/b] Up to 2 months.
Upon division, the newborn Bloxori are minuscule beings with about 5 centimeters at max and 5-10 grams of weight, they can not move by themselves instead being dragged by the sea currents, early food vacuoles are responsible for their food, as the water enter, their contractile vacuole filter the excessive water and bring nutrients to where it should be.
The mortality rate on this phase is big, as most Fragments get eaten by fish at this phase, their nucleus need much nutrients and water to expand itself and develop organelles, at this phase, the Bloxori are translucid, so much they are almost invisible to others, making hard their detection and therefore "saving".
[b]Formative[/b]( From 3-6 months)
On this phase, the Bloxori will begin to develope Organelles, and the structure of the reproductive nucleus begin to develop, despite slow, they can swim against the current if weak or not too strong, they also begin to have a thicker layer to protect their cytoplasm, organelles and nucleus.
The formative period makes the Bloxori quite quickly expand their size, to around 30 CM max and 250 Grams.
Note: Bloxori colonies, made up of around 50-2500 of them, created next to sea currents to capture baby Bloxori so ensure they will not die on open sea, and bring them to nurseries on coral reefs, where they can grow, develop  and create better connection symbiosis with bacterias.
[b]Explorer phase[/b] Between 6 months - 2 years.
During this phase, the  young Bloxori pseudopods develop greatly, and they can move faster than ever, moving farther from the colonies to explore the seas, and even potentially land, thought rare, they also tend to try hunting in groups, usually their preys are smaller planktons or fish.
During this phase their reproduction nucleus stop developing until get older.
This phase is not only  exploring seas, as this phase seems taht Bloxori also will develop communication and will be integrated better into colonies as they learn more about communicating and living in colonies.
They not grow much on this phase compared to previous, and can have about 50cm or 70cm and 600Grams of weight, however their mobility is something to be admired.
[b]Ascending/Adolescent[/b]: 2 years -6 years.
A phase of great development, the Ascending phase is where the reproductive nucleus of Bloxori is fully functional, and ocasionally, if requirements such as great mass and size, and abundance of resources, a little part of their reproductive nucleus expell small part of it outside the body and ....then taht is how a Bloxori is born.
Their bodies begin to gain shape and colour, which varies from, shades of blue, green and even orange, tho the last is rarer, also their skin begins to become more crystaline, and even bioluminescent.
Their communication is at peak, their reproduction can make up around 3 Bloxori surge during this phase, while their Nucleus begins to develope better the feelings thought.
They grow much more during this phase, and can reach 1 meter and 4 Kg
[b]Juvenile/Crystaline[/b]. 6 years-12 years.
This phase is marked by intense appearance changes and mass increase, this phase they can grow up to 1,20 M, largest individuals tho have about 1,50M, while weight increases due their silicate skeleton expansion, their appearance reach at it peak, as "peak of Bloxori beauty standards", their reproduction reach at it highest point, with over dozens of fragments can be produced by a single juvenile Bloxori.
Their regeneration rate is at it peak, their health, everything, the healthiest and best phase of the Bloxori, their mass at this point can reach 10-15Kg.
[b]Adulthood[/b]. 12-25 years
The longest phase of Aquatic Bloxori, their reproduction slowly decrease, but not much, those who take care of Forming Bloxori, teaching, and administering colonies are in their adulthood, hunters and gatherers are from this phase, leading expeditions to outer colonies to expand, and bring food.
Their size and weight begins to decrease slowly after this period, their size varies between 1,10-1m while weight decrease to 6KG.
[b]Elder[/b], +25.
The most venerable stage of a aquatic bloxorior, at elder phase their bodies slowly begin to fail, as their retractile vacuoles begin to fail filtrating water, making "bloats" more common, their regeneration rate is really slow, any wound on their bodies can cause potential death, and they are infertile, at this age, they exile themselves from colonies to die in peace, is unknown, but most Bloxorior die around their 30s, due their exile is unknown how much they can actually live, as when they "desintegrate" barely anything rest from their bodies.
Their size and weight are irrelevant, as they slowly die, it also does slowly reduces, as their nucleus and organelles begin to fail...
[b]Land Life cycles[/b].
In general, life cycles of Land Bloxorior are...slower, such as the Fragment, which happens when a piece of a Bloxorior leave a fragment of itself on a tree in a "gelatinous mass" on trees, this cycle lasts around 2 years, as they slowly grow, the explorer phase never happens, Juvenile phase happens between 2-15 years, while their "Juvenile phase" lasts between 15-40 years, their silicate skeleton is also present, tho the reproduction rate is a bit slower, with a average of 8 fragments per Bloxorior.
At Adulthood, which lasts around 40-80 years, they take groups to migrate between caves and lead expeditions with their communities and groups, while +80 is old age, while they are also infertile, do not exile themselves, instead take more "leadership" positions.
The juvenile Bloxori are the most commonly used for medicine as they have larger regeneration rate.
